item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las kyi rig 'dzin rgyud skong dang khyad par skong ba
item.coloph: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i phrin las kyi nyer 'kho rig 'dzin rgyud skong dang / khyad par skong ba bcas pa mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa rin po che'i bka' pheb ma ldog te/ drung mu ming gis gnas mdun stag rtse g.yung drung gling nas sa rta zla 10 tshes 13 la bgyis te phul ba dge/ bkra shis//
